name: Medieval Castle Hidden Pieces
author: Addicting Games
description: Medieval Castle Hidden Pieces is a hidden object game for you to play!. This online game uses backgrounds of mysterious castles that have long been abandoned. You will find portraits, vases, jewelry, and other remains of these ancient castles. Instead of finding whole pieces like other hidden object games, this game presents an extra challenge by having you find broken pieces of an item. There are 10 levels of this hidden object game for you to conquer! There is no time to waste with the clock ticking! Find all the items within the allotted time and without making any mistakes. If you cannot complete it on time,  you will not advance to the next level.
